design_philosophy.core_directive: Radical anti-template composition. Reject standard SaaS clichés (4-stat-card rows, standard hero screenshot-on-right, symmetric split forms). Use asymmetric Tetris/Bento grids, overlapping kinetic typography, dynamic interactive simulators, high-density data visualization, and tactile editorial contrasts.
brand_pillars: Tactile Warmth & Authority: Warm cream background (#FFF8F1) + Ink black typography (#171412) for high readability without cold corporate sterility.
Kinetic Energy: Vibrant signal orange (#F9622C) primary CTAs with subtle warning yellow (#FFC94A) highlighter marks.
Asymmetric Tension: Non-uniform bento grid ratios (1x2, 2x2, 3x1), overlapping visual containers, and offset text alignments.
Density & Clarity: Dashboard prioritizes immediate actionability, GitHub-style activity heatmaps, live pipeline funnels, and real-time activity streams.

landing_hero.anti_pattern_avoided: DO NOT use standard 'Badge -> Headline -> Subtitle -> 2 Buttons -> Right Screenshot' layout.
landing_hero.new_compositional_structure: 3-Column Kinetic Overlap Grid (grid-cols-12). Left col-span-7: Massive overlapping headline ('Outbound That Converts Before You Hit Send') with embedded interactive lead counter and floating live metric chip. Center/Right col-span-5: Interactive Live AI Prospecting Console (real-time lead generator simulator where users type a target ICP and watch verified leads fill in). Bottom span: Tilted ticker ribbon with live meeting bookings.
landing_hero.visual_enhancers: Atmospheric blurred blobs (radial-gradient orange & yellow), rotating outcome pill tags, organic curved lines, micro-interactions on hover.

dashboard_bento_grid.anti_pattern_avoided: DO NOT use '4 equal stat cards top row + 1 line chart bottom row'.
dashboard_bento_grid.new_bento_mode: MODE B Asymmetric High-Density Grid (lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6).

testing_strategy.mandatory_data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, filter pills, dropdowns, table rows, modal triggers) MUST contain descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. MAINTAIN DESIGN TOKENS: Keep warm cream background (#FFF8F1), orange primary (#F9622C), yellow accent (#FFC94A), Clash Display font for headings, Inter font for body text, rounded-full pill buttons, and rounded-[24px] cards.
2. ELIMINATE AI SLOP LAYOUTS: Avoid standard row-based 4-stat cards or plain right-hand screenshot hero sections. Construct distinct asymmetrical layouts.
3. IMPLEMENT INTERACTIVE PLAYGROUNDS: Provide interactive lead generator console directly in the Hero, live ROI slider in Auth, and full filtering/searchable tables in Dashboard.
4. ENSURE RESPONSIVENESS & ACCESSIBILITY: Mobile first grid breakdowns (grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-4) with high contrast text colors and strict WCAG compliance.

5. TESTABILITY: Include data-testid on every single click/type target across Landing, Dashboard, ICP Engine, Lead Sourcing, Outreach, Scheduler, Proposal Generator, Reports, Login, Signup, and Forgot Password.
